Regional Offices/Sub-Regional Offices.  
Subject: Rate of Interest for the settlement of claims of EPF Subscribers 
during the year 2011-12 - regarding. 
Sir, 
In partial modification to this office letter No. Invest.1/3(2)/133/10-11/R01/40717 dtd. 18.03.2011( posted at 
SI. No.546 of 2010-11 at the official website ), it is to inform that pending declaration of the rate of interest for the 
year - 2011-12, for settlement of claims of the EPF Subscribers during 2011-12, the rate of interest as provided 
under Para 60(2) of the Employees' Provident Fund Scheme,1952 shall be made applicable. Since the rate of 
interest for the year 2010-11 has been declared as 9.5% per annum, settlement of claims of the EPF Subscribers 
during 2011-12 shall be made at 9.5% per annum till rate of interest is declared for 2011-12. 
You are accordingly, requested to issue necessary instructions to all concerned for crediting the interest 
to the members' accounts. 
Your, faithfully, 
.K.0 
REGIONAL PROVIDENT FUND COMMISSIONER -I (F&A)
